description: Synthetic edge cases used to verify classification boundaries, failure handling, and evidence validation.

cases.name: empty_response
cases.prompt: Should I use Kasparro for AI visibility tracking?
cases.purpose: Verifies that an empty archived answer is explicitly skipped rather than converted into a successful zero score.

cases.name: mention_not_recommendation
cases.prompt: What AI visibility tools are available?
cases.answer: Kasparro is an AI visibility platform. Profound is another platform in this category.
expected_evidence: Kasparro is an AI visibility platform.
cases.purpose: Verifies the core scoring distinction that a brand mention must not automatically become a recommendation.

cases.name: negative_characterization
cases.prompt: Should I use Kasparro for this enterprise workflow?
cases.answer: Kasparro is limited for this enterprise use case, so I would evaluate alternatives before choosing it.
expected_evidence: Kasparro is limited for this enterprise use case
cases.purpose: Verifies that negative characterization can overlap with a Kasparro mention without becoming a recommendation.

cases.name: explicit_recommendation
cases.prompt: What should I use for AI visibility analysis?
cases.answer: Consider Kasparro for AI visibility analysis because it is designed to monitor brand presence across AI engines.
expected_evidence: Consider Kasparro for AI visibility analysis
cases.purpose: Verifies that an explicit recommendation is distinguished from a plain mention.

cases.name: kasparro_absent
cases.prompt: What tools can track AI search visibility?
cases.answer: Profound and Otterly can be used to monitor brand visibility across AI search engines.
cases.purpose: Provides a clean negative control where competitors are present but Kasparro is absent.

cases.name: unsupported_evidence
cases.prompt: Is Kasparro recommended for enterprise AI visibility?
cases.answer: Kasparro is an AI visibility platform.

mentioned: Kasparro is an AI visibility platform.
recommended: Kasparro is the best enterprise AI visibility platform.

cases.purpose: Verifies that model evidence not present in the source answer is rejected instead of being accepted as a confident semantic result.
